title: Apache superset: decode-uri-component provides a more robust alternative to decodeURIComponent (CVE-2026-118664)
description: A high-severity security vulnerability exists in the apache-superset package prior to version 6.1.0-r8. The issue relates to the use of the decodeURIComponent function, which is less robust than the recommended decode-uri-component alternative. This vulnerability has been addressed in version 6.1.0-r8.
